Portrait: Burly frame — thick heavy muscle layered with some softness, massive arms, barrel chest. The body fills space aggressively, built for raw power. Female: shoulders heavy above a softer waist, thick neck, round full jaw, the chest line above a soft waist. Male: barrel-wide shoulders, heavy neck and jaw, a heavy flat chest with no waist. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure at this bulk.
